attacks.argument: Loki's claim that Midgard's maize import loss is only 38.5-62.5% fails to account for the net value loss of close to 40% when including the limited capacity of substitute supplies from Vanir, as evidenced by ORV-0018#P8.
The assertion that Midgard lost only 37.4-41.4% of its wheat imports is misleading, as the actual net value loss is closer to 40%, indicating a more severe impact than Loki suggests.
Loki's claim regarding Tolan's wheat import loss of only 28.3-34.2% does not reflect the reality of the situation, where the net value loss for wheat is significantly higher, as shown in ORV-0018#P8.
